scope: These 13 selected attempts cannot rank models. They include 5 completed runs from 16 September, 4 local runner-failed records from 15 September, and 4 stopped attempts from 23 September. Searches for 17 to 19 September found no matches. Local report-to-capture links are provisional; overlapping archive files are deduplicated by content. Other runs may exist. We did not rerun historical tests or regrade results.
privacy: This site is for evaluators. Exports exclude raw transcripts, private tests, reference-based grading explanations, hidden reasoning, credentials and proxy diagnostics. A recovered agent implementation is visible. Do not mount this directory in a solver workspace.
